description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

B4Corp is hiring an Expert Software Developer to support its client’s mission-focused work. The role involves software development and maintenance, SharePoint administration, and cloud and systems engineering.
Expert Software Engineer developing Java applications, administering SharePoint, maintaining legacy platforms, and configuring AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines

Requirements:
• Position Requires a Top Secret (TS/SCI) Clearance with a Polygraph
• Requires Strong SharePoint Administrator Demonstrated experience and understanding of Java programming, to include Java scripting
• Demonstrated experience with the following languages and technologies: Python, Apache Tomcat, ElasticSearch, Oracle, and GitHub
• Demonstrated experience with Continuous Integration and Deployment processes such as Nexus, GitHub, Jenkins, and scripting tools
• Demonstrated experience with developing websites, or other interfaces using tools such as WordPress, SharePoint, JIRA, and Confluence
• Demonstrated experience overseeing and conducting ongoing maintenance of legacy applications such as JIRA, SharePoint, and Domino
• Demonstrated experience setting up and managing servers in the Cloud such as AWS
• Demonstrated experience with requirements tracking
• Demonstrated experience creating and configuring virtual networks
• Demonstrated experience configuring security groups
• Demonstrated experience with services-oriented architectures, security requirements, operating environments and systems engineering concepts
